settings.title: Settings
settings.library_hint: Database, images and 3D files all live here, on your own computer.
settings.demo_mode_hint: Every AI call returns a built-in sample and costs nothing. Walk through the pipeline without any keys.
settings.config_readonly: The config file could not be read at startup. To avoid overwriting it, settings will not be saved in this run.
settings.keys_hint: Keys are stored only in this computer's system credential manager. They are never written to config files or uploaded.
settings.key_deepseek_hint: Required. A research run costs roughly ¥0.3–0.5.
settings.key_zhipu_search_hint: Optional, about ¥0.01 per query. Without it, research falls back to your notes plus the model's general knowledge.
settings.key_minimax_hint: Optional. Text-to-image, about ¥0.03 per image; cannot edit an existing image. Note: "Test connection" really generates one image and is billed for it.
settings.key_qwen_image: Qwen Image (Alibaba Cloud Bailian) · generate and edit
settings.key_qwen_image_hint: Optional. Can edit by instruction (swap the background, recolor, subject unchanged), about ¥0.2 per image. Note: "Test connection" really generates one image.
settings.image_hint: With both configured: generation uses the one you pick (Auto = the cheaper one); instruction edits always use the one that can edit.
settings.image_minimax_url_hint: Defaults to the mainland China site. International accounts should enter the international endpoint.
settings.image_qwen_url_hint: If the Bailian console gives you a workspace-specific address (https://<workspace>.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com), enter it here.

cad.engine_download_title: A new modeling engine has to be downloaded
cad.engine_download_hint: This version uses a new modeling engine, about {{ mb }} MB, downloaded only once. Everything else keeps working.
cad.engine_missing_title: The CAD engine is not installed
cad.engine_missing_hint: Code CAD runs model-written scripts locally with build123d (OpenCascade kernel). In a dev checkout run scripts\setup-cad-engine.ps1; release builds will offer a one-click engine pack here.
cad.engine_installing_title: Preparing the CAD engine (first time only)
cad.engine_installing_hint: The engine ships inside the installer: nothing to download, nothing else to install. Unpacking about {{ mb }} MB, usually around a minute.
cad.engine_unpack_failed_hint: The CAD engine could not be unpacked (low disk space or security software can cause this). Free about 1 GB and press “Check again”. Everything else keeps working.
cad.refs_hint: Product renders, photos or screenshots, up to 4. They are downscaled and stripped of EXIF (location, device) on import, because they are sent to the vision model.
cad.brief_placeholder:
Size, purpose, features that matter…
e.g. 60 mm long, three slots, holds a 5 mm cable
cad.spec_hint: Confirm sizes and features before generating. Fixing the spec is far cheaper than fixing the model.
cad.spec_feature_desc: What it is and where it sits
cad.spec_dims_hint: Dimensions, one per line: name = value
cad.spec_assumptions: Assumed by the model (not visible in the image)
cad.spec_unsuitable: This shape is a poor fit for code CAD: {{ reason }}. Organic shapes are better served by AI mesh generation.
cad.spec_bad_size: The overall size needs three positive numbers (mm)
cad.spec_no_features: The spec needs at least one feature
cad.spec_bad_dim: Cannot read this dimension line: {{ line }} (format: name = value)
cad.demo_note: Demo mode: the spec and scripts are canned, but they run on the real local engine (the first draft carries a deliberate bug to show the repair loop).
cad.step_repairing: Draft {{ attempt }} has {{ problems }} problem(s), repairing…
cad.no_versions: No models yet. Add a reference image, draft the spec and generate — or write a build123d script under “Code” and run it.
cad.code_placeholder: Write or paste a build123d script here (assign the final shape to result)…
cad.params_hint: Edit a number and press Enter: rebuilt locally, no model call, no cost.
cad.no_params: This script declares no adjustable parameters.
cad.edit_placeholder: e.g. make the slot bottoms round; add an M3 hole at each end
cad.edit_hint: Only the relevant feature sections change; everything else stays byte-for-byte. The changed sections are recorded on the new version.
cad.review_hint: Four rendered views are compared with the reference images by the vision model.
cad.review_no_refs: This version has no reference image to compare against.
cad.snapped: The part was snapped onto the build plate (z = 0) automatically
cad.usage: {{ calls }} model call(s) · {{ runs }} run(s) · ¥{{ yuan }} · {{ secs }} s
cad.failed_hint: The last draft is in the Code box and each draft's errors are listed below. Fix it by hand and run, or adjust the spec and retry.

cad.p_solids: The model consists of {{ count }} disconnected solids

cad.p_size: Size differs from the spec: got {{ got }}, spec {{ want }}

cad.p_param_range: Parameter {{ name }} = {{ value }} is outside its declared range

research.title: Research
research.subtitle: Find out whether it is worth making: demand, competitors, price band, risks. Adopt a good opportunity as a project, or research for an existing one.

imagery.title: Images
imagery.subtitle: Generate and refine images with AI, one message at a time. The selected image is the current one: what you say next edits it.
imagery.no_provider: No image API key yet · open Settings
imagery.no_planner: A DeepSeek key is also needed (it reads the image and writes the prompt every turn) · open Settings
imagery.demo_note: Demo mode: images are placeholder drawings made on this machine. Nothing is sent or billed.
imagery.no_boards: No boards yet. A board is one theme: references, the conversation, and every image made along the way.
imagery.empty_hint: Create a board and say what you need: a white-background modeling reference, an in-use scene, or a post cover.
imagery.delete_confirm: The board's conversation and images will no longer be shown (the image files stay in your library).
imagery.viewer_empty_hint: Say something on the right, e.g. "a three-slot desk cable clip on white"
imagery.chat_empty_hint: The first message generates. After that each message either edits the current image ("make the background a wooden desk"), generates a new batch ("a few more"), or just asks a question. You can attach reference images.
imagery.composer_new_placeholder: e.g. a three-slot desk cable clip, matte blue, white background (Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line)
imagery.composer_edit_placeholder: How should the current image change? wooden desk background / make it orange / a few more
imagery.attach_image: Attach an image (the selected image counts too; 3 per turn at most)
imagery.phase_rendering: {{ provider }} is generating {{ count }} image(s); this usually takes 10–60 s…
imagery.remove_image: Remove this image from the board
imagery.remove_image_confirm: The image will no longer appear on this board (the file stays in your library). Images edited from it are not affected.
imagery.images_removed: This batch has been removed from the board
imagery.compliance_note: Use AI images for post illustrations and non-first listing images only: Xiaohongshu requires the first product image to be a real front-view photo, and AI content must be declared when publishing.

studio.title: Modeling
studio.subtitle: From an image or a sentence to a parametric 3D model — then refine it with AI, one message at a time.
studio.no_designs: No designs yet. A design is one part: its references, spec, conversation and every version.
studio.empty_title: Start from a sentence or a picture
studio.empty_hint: Create a design and tell the AI what part you want.
studio.demo_note: Demo mode: the AI replies are canned (two edits and one answer), but scripts run on the real local engine.
studio.delete_confirm: The conversation and versions of this design will no longer be shown (model files stay in the library).
studio.viewer_empty_hint: Tell the AI what you want, on the right
studio.params_empty: Once a model exists its adjustable parameters appear here: change a number to rebuild, no AI, no cost.
studio.chat_empty_title: What part do you want to make?
studio.chat_empty_hint: Describe the purpose and rough size; product shots, photos or sketches help. I will draft a spec for you to confirm, then build it — after that, just tell me what to change.
studio.refs_ready: The reference image is attached. Add the purpose and rough size for a much better spec: real-world scale can't be read off a picture.
studio.refs_opening: Model this reference image, about 60 mm long overall
studio.composer_new_placeholder: e.g. a desk-edge cable clip, 60 mm long, three slots that hold a 5 mm cable
studio.composer_edit_placeholder: Say what to change: widen the slots to 8 mm / add an M3 hole here / does this need supports? (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
studio.pick_hint: Turn on, then click the model to tell the AI "I mean here"
studio.suggest_chamfer: Add a small chamfer to the bottom edge against elephant foot
studio.suggest_support: Does this need supports to print?
studio.spec_hint: Tell me what is off ("make it 80 long"), or press "Edit spec" to change it item by item.
studio.built_default: The model has been generated from the spec.
studio.load_failed_code: Put the last draft into the editor
studio.event_manual: Code edited by hand and run
studio.live_code: Writing code · {{ n }} lines so far

pricing.title: Prototype & pricing
pricing.subtitle: Know before listing: what to charge, what you earn, and how many orders a day you can take. Change any number and the right side recalculates at once.
pricing.no_projects: No projects yet. A cost model belongs to a project: create one under Projects first.
pricing.empty_title: Pick a project to do the math
pricing.empty_hint: Cost = material + machine time + labor + packaging + shipping subsidy; failed prints are amortized in.
pricing.sec_unit_hint: Trust your slicer or a real print for grams and hours; waste and failures are amortized into the cost.
pricing.use_actuals: Use the latest successful print's actuals
pricing.use_observed_rate: Your print runs show {{ rate }} success, use it
pricing.no_model_hint: This project has no built model yet, so grams and hours cannot be estimated for you: enter the slicer's numbers, or model it first.
pricing.printer: Printer (pick a profile to fill the numbers)
pricing.sec_channel_hint: Fee presets were checked in 2026-09 and platforms change them at will: trust your seller console and edit freely.
pricing.not_ready: Grams and print time are still empty: this cost is labor and extras only, a floor price.
pricing.sec_price_hint: Three suggested prices work back from target margins and only round up to x5.9 / x9.9. Pick one or type your own.
pricing.warn_loss: At this price every sale loses money.
pricing.warn_margin: Margin is under 50%: a solo seller's capacity cannot live on thin margins, so raise the price or redesign to cut cost.
pricing.warn_per_hour: Profit per machine hour is under ¥{{ floor }}: this item is not worth the printer time; long prints need a higher profit per unit.
pricing.warn_above_band: Above the researched competitor band (¥{{ hi }}): it needs differentiation to hold, such as original design, a series, or personalization.
pricing.warn_below_band: Below the competitor band (¥{{ lo }}): do not start a price war, wholesalers will win it.
pricing.no_band: No research for this project, so no competitor price band to show.
pricing.band_line: Competitor band ¥{{ lo }} – ¥{{ hi }} (from research) · grey ticks are the suggested prices, the block is yours
pricing.capacity_unknown: Enter the print time to see capacity.
pricing.capacity_line: About {{ per_day }} good units a day (failures already deducted) · at most {{ in_48h }} units within 48 hours. Beyond that, list as pre-order: in-stock items on Xiaohongshu must ship within 48 hours.
pricing.capacity_profit: With every printer busy, this item tops out at about ¥{{ yuan }} profit a day.
pricing.sec_runs_hint: Log every print, failures too: the failure rate is part of the cost and the reasons drive redesigns.
pricing.run_reason_placeholder: Why it failed (required): warping / clog / supports collapsed / wrong size…
pricing.run_note_placeholder: Notes: layer height, infill, which printer…
pricing.printers_hint: Use the average power while printing, not the rated peak; calibrate grams per hour from your own print runs.
pricing.printer_name_placeholder: e.g. A1 mini (the one in the study)
pricing.defaults_hint: New projects start from these; changing them does not touch projects you already priced.

publish.title: Publish
publish.subtitle: AI drafts the note and the listing, a compliance check runs, and everything is packed for publishing — you press Publish yourself.
publish.voice_hint: The tone used when drafting copy, for every project in this library. Empty = concise, sincere, no hype.
publish.voice_placeholder: e.g. friendly, first person, short sentences; no exclamation marks
publish.empty_hint: For a product that has been prototyped and priced: draft the note and the listing, check compliance, and build a publish pack.
publish.no_note: No notes yet. Pick angles and draft with AI, or start a blank one.
publish.points_placeholder:
Three slots that hold thick and thin cables
Magnetic base, no drilling
publish.images_hint: {{ min }}–{{ max }} images; the first one is the cover
publish.no_images_picked: No images yet. Click one below to add it.
publish.pool_hint: Images available in this project (click to add / remove; AI marks generated images):
publish.pool_empty: This project has no images yet: generate and adopt some under Images, or import a photo.
publish.pack_hint: Processed images and copy, in a folder of the library
publish.why_manual: Why there is no one-click publishing: Xiaohongshu has no publishing API, and accounts that publish through tools or scripts get banned (official notice, March 2026). The app drafts and packs; you publish.
publish.way_a: Option A · Publish on this computer
publish.way_b: Option B · Publish from your phone
publish.share_hint: Scan with a phone on the same Wi-Fi: copy the text with one tap and long-press images to save them. Windows Firewall asks once — choose Allow. Sharing stops when you leave this page.
publish.share_scan: Scan with your phone camera (same Wi-Fi as this computer).
publish.share_local_only: No LAN address found: the page can only be opened on this computer right now.
publish.advanced: Link saved — the project moved to Operating
publish.override_hint: Some hard checks failed (the red items on the right). Fixing them is safest; to skip anyway, write down why — the reason is kept with the pack.
publish.override_placeholder: e.g. the flagged word is part of the product line's name
publish.l_first_not_photo: The first listing image must be a real photo, not an AI image — move a photo to the front
publish.l_ai_images: {{ count }} AI-generated image(s): tick the platform's AI content declaration when publishing
publish.l_extreme: Superlative “{{ word }}” in {{ field }} (not allowed by ad law or the platform)
publish.l_medical: Health / efficacy claim “{{ word }}” in {{ field }}
publish.l_ip: Brand or character name “{{ word }}” in {{ field }}: not allowed without a licence
publish.l_fake_review: “{{ word }}” in {{ field }}: review incentives are penalised
publish.l_cat_kids: Mentions “{{ word }}”: children's products need certification — do not sell it as a toy
publish.l_cat_electric: Mentions “{{ word }}”: powered products and lamps need certification
publish.l_cat_food: Mentions “{{ word }}”: 3D prints are not food safe — say so clearly
publish.l_cat_weapon: Mentions “{{ word }}”: blade or weapon shapes are often taken down
publish.l_price_below_cost: Price ¥{{ price }} is below the unit cost
publish.l_license_nc: A non-commercial model cannot be sold
